text.value: Laboratory Report

tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The urine findings indicate a urinary tract infection (UTI) with significant bacteriuria (E. coli >100,000 CFU/mL), pyuria (elevated leukocytes), hematuria, nitrites, and proteinuria. The low specific gravity may suggest dilute urine. No casts were seen, which makes upper tract involvement less likely, but clinical correlation is advised. Prompt antimicrobial therapy and follow-up are recommended.
